summary: Provider identity uses the owner go-live state returned by the existing onboarding read; payout verification is labeled separately and provider profile edits open the existing basics section.
Business work is shown only when merchant_staff is enabled and list_my_business_memberships returns active rows; own-provider switching and existing venue/shop listing entries remain separate.

Provider, admin, membership, balance, and coin-policy reads expose loading or retryable unavailable states; a failed provider read does not route to onboarding and a failed balance read does not display zero.
The Seva Coins history entry remains visible when earning and redemption are both off, with paused-capability wording.
Service activation says enabled; services and reviews have independent retryable reads, and service-write rollback is retained.

codespace.execution: Loaded the current-main helper in memory and ran it in Q:\repos\quickserve-o23-id07; no Windows package install or app test/build was run.

selectedCases: ID-ACCOUNT-CUSTOMER keeps own-provider onboarding and listing paths separate from memberships
ID-ACCOUNT-OWNER uses canonical go-live readiness and routes profile edits to basics
ID-ACCOUNT-MEMBER shows Business work for real memberships without owner payout controls
ID-ACCOUNT-ADMIN distinguishes an admin read error from a negative result and retries
ID-ACCOUNT-PROVIDER-READ-ERROR does not switch to onboarding until the own-provider read succeeds
ID-ACCOUNT-WALLET-OFF keeps Seva Coins history visible when both reward capabilities are off
ID-ACCOUNT-COIN-READ-ERROR shows unavailable instead of zero and retries the balance
ID-ACCOUNT-MERCHANT-STAFF-OFF does not read or expose member work
ID-SERVICE-ENABLED-NOT-LIVE calls an enabled service enabled, not live
ID-REVIEWS-ERROR-NOT-EMPTY shows a review-specific retry without retrying services
ID-MEMBER-NO-OWNER-KYC hides payout controls from a delegated business context
ID-SERVICE-READ-ERROR shows a service-specific retry without a false empty state
ID-SERVICE-WRITE-ROLLBACK restores the previous service state when saving fails
labels provider verification as payout verification, independently of service state
